title: Target-adapted Green-Bessel SVGD: uniform-in-time propagation of chaos and last-iterate consistency
summary: We prove uniform-in-time propagation of chaos and last-iterate consistency for a target-adapted Stein variational gradient descent (SVGD) flow on compact connected manifolds. The target has a smooth positive density, and the particles start independently from a fixed smooth nonnegative density ratio. The construction uses the Green--Bessel operator $Q_{r,π}=A_π^{-1}(\mathrm{Id}+A_π)^{-r}$ of the reversible target Langevin generator. Sufficient Bessel smoothing gives a scalar kernel with finite diagonal, and a positive matrix lift realizes its potential force as a Stein velocity. Population…
